mapper.select: SELECT account_id, trading_mode, snapshot_date, total_value, cash_balance, daily_pnl, daily_pnl_rate FROM account_snapshot WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND trading_mode = #{tradingMode} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY snapshot_date DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account_snapshot (account_id, trading_mode, snapshot_date, total_value, cash_balance, daily_pnl, daily_pnl_rate) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{tradingMode}, #{snapshotDate}, #{totalValue}, #{cashBalance}, #{dailyPnl}, #{dailyPnlRate}) ON CONFLICT (account_id, trading_mode, snapshot_date) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL DO UPDATE SET total_value = EXCLUDED.total_value, cash_balance = EXCLUDED.cash_balance, daily_pnl = EXCLUDED.daily_pnl, daily_pnl_rate = EXCLUDED.daily_pnl_rate
